  1. Bronzer: Apply bronzer to the forehead, cheekbones, and jawline to add warmth and dimension.

  5. Build: Layer the products gradually until you achieve your desired makeup look.

Pro Tip: Use a light hand when applying powder products and build the color gradually for a naturally blended finish.
